purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for Routine definitions and active/historical runner executions, including step state, dispatch traces, bounds, failures and originating Event/Trigger refs.

topics.name: Runner Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for Routine definitions and active/historical runner executions, including step state, dispatch traces, bounds, failures and originating Event/Trigger refs.

semantics.identity_rule: Routine definition identity and runner execution identity are shown separately.
semantics.action_rule: Start/go/cancel/retry controls, if exposed, invoke separate authorized commands.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing runner does not grant execution/control authority.
semantics.redaction_rule: Restricted arguments/results are redacted according to policy.
semantics.trace_rule: Displayed steps retain exact command/dispatch refs.
semantics.layout_rule: Visual ordering follows explicit step sequence and does not invent execution semantics.

invariants.rule: Routine definitions and runner executions are separate canonical identities; runners execute explicit ordered routine content through the normal governed dispatch boundary.
